name: scheduled-workflows
description: Runs scheduled workflows inside the session pod: executes a .fkst/workflows/<id>.toml definition's run/task steps in declared order and reports each run to its schedule definition issue as an fkst-cron-run:v1 record. Declares NO work labels — a scheduled run is woken by the run issue the control-plane clock creates, which already carries the session's own label. Compose it alongside a session's ordinary adapters; on a session with no scheduled workflows it boots and does nothing.
